question: 94 + 61 - 38 + (27 + 21) times 2 - 91 = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Solve bracket first and then group terms for faster addition/subtraction.

Value = 94 + 61 − 38 + (48 × 2) − 91

Value = 155 − 38 + 96 − 91

Value = 117 + 5 = 122

**∴ The correct answer is 122.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: 94 + 61 − 38 + (27 + 21) × 2 − 91

Formula used: BODMAS (Bracket, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction)

⇒ 94 + 61 − 38 + 48 × 2 − 91

⇒ 94 + 61 − 38 + 96 − 91

⇒ 155 − 38 + 96 − 91

⇒ 117 + 96 − 91

⇒ 213 − 91

⇒ 122

**∴ The correct answer is 122.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

It defines the sequence of operations: Brackets first, then Orders (powers/roots), then Division and Multiplication (left to right), and finally Addition and Subtraction (left to right).

Grouping Method

To simplify large expressions, group all positive terms together and all negative terms together before the final subtraction.
